spec.text: Image 1 is the couple in their registration-day outfits; image 2 is a real photo of rice paddies in Yunlin at dawn; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Dawn over the misty rice paddies of Yunlin from image 2: seen from behind, the couple in their registration-day outfits walk hand in hand along a narrow earthen ridge path into the soft morning light, distant mountains. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
